name: What kind of paint is best for rental properties?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for rental properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: For rental properties, durable, washable, and low-VOC (volatile organic compound) paints are generally recommended. Eggshell or satin finishes are popular choices for walls as they offer a good balance of durability and aesthetic appeal, and are easier to clean than matte finishes. For high-traffic areas like kitchens and bathrooms, semi-gloss or gloss paints provide maximum durability and moisture resistance. Opting for neutral, light colors can also make units feel larger and appeal to a wider range of potential tenants, simplifying future touch-ups.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable, washable, low-VOC paints with eggshell or satin finishes are best for rental properties. Semi-gloss works well in high-moisture areas.
